title: Build an Electron app with <react>React</react> and <ts>TypeScript</ts>
tip: Please try pressing F12 to open the devTool
aboutDesc: This is an Electron application built with React, TypeScript, and Ant Design.
aboutTagline: Build your developer workbench, brick by brick.
aboutFooter: A workbench assembled brick by brick
memoStickyDesc: Capture ideas on colorful sticky notes, organized by tags with batch editing.
devToolsDesc: Handy developer tools: random passwords, codecs, JSON, timestamps, PDF processing and more.
preferencesDesc: Control startup and window close behavior
openAtLoginDesc: Start BrickWorks automatically when you sign in
closeToTrayDesc: When enabled, closing hides the app to the system tray instead of quitting
showWindowShortcutDesc: Press the shortcut from any app to show the window; press again while focused to hide it
shortcutDesc: Set a global shortcut to show or hide the main window
shortcutRecording: Press the new combination (Esc to cancel)
shortcutHint: Combinations taken by other apps can't be picked up by recording. Use the pencil to type one instead; conflicts are detected on save.
shortcutConflict: This shortcut is already taken by another app. Choose another one
themeDesc: Choose light, dark, or follow the system
memoStickyDeleteTagConfirm: Notes in this tag will become uncategorized.
memoStickyNoNotes: No notes yet. Click + to create.
devToolRandomPasswordDesc: Combine digits, letters, and special characters into random passwords with configurable length.
toolNotImplemented: This tool is not yet implemented
devToolImageToBase64Desc: Convert images to Base64 via URL, clipboard, or file upload, and reverse Base64 back to image.
imgToBase64UrlPlaceholder: Enter image URL, press Enter to fetch
imgToBase64PasteHint: Click to read image from clipboard
imgToBase64SelectFile: Click to select an image file
imgToBase64ReverseHint: Paste Base64 data and click Render
imgToBase64FetchError: Failed to fetch image, check URL
devToolJsonBeautifyDesc: Format, minify, sort, and decode JSON data with BigInt support and themes.
devToolCodecDesc: Convert between Unicode, URL, Base64, MD5, Hex, Gzip and more encoding formats.
devToolTimestampDesc: Convert between localized date/time text and Unix timestamps.
timestampNoResult: Enter a value to see the result
devToolUuidGenDesc: Generate UUID v4, Twitter Snowflake IDs, and NanoIDs; parse a Snowflake ID into timestamp, worker ID, sequence and more.
uuidGenSnowflakeEpochNote: Based on the Twitter epoch (1288834974657 ms)
uuidGenNanoidCustomHint: Empty to use the selected alphabet
uuidGenParsePlaceholder: Enter a Snowflake ID, press Enter to parse...
uuidGenParseNoResult: Enter a Snowflake ID to see its fields
devToolQrCodeDesc: Generate QR codes with custom colors and a logo; decode QR codes from clipboard (screenshot paste), file, URL, or drag-and-drop.
qrGenEcHint: Use H (highest) when adding a logo or for longer content
qrDecPasteHint: Click to read an image from the clipboard, or press Ctrl+V to paste a screenshot
qrDecSelectFile: Click to select a QR image
qrDecUrlPlaceholder: Enter image URL, press Enter to decode
qrDecDropHint: Drag & drop an image here to decode
devToolSvgToImgDesc: Convert SVG files to PNG, JPG, or WEBP with custom output size; supports drag-and-drop and URL import.
svgToImgDropHint: Drop an SVG file here, or click to select
svgToImgUrlPlaceholder: Enter an SVG URL, press Enter to import
svgToImgJpgNoAlpha: JPG does not support transparency; white will be used
svgToImgNoResult: Import an SVG to see the preview
devToolPdfImageAnnotateDesc: Preview PDFs and images, drag to add highlighted annotations with color and notes. Supports zoom and page navigation; annotations scale together with the preview.
devToolPdfMergeSplitDesc: Merge multiple PDFs into one, or split a PDF by page and by page ranges for download.
pdfMsMergeHint: Select multiple PDFs, reorder them, then merge into one file.
pdfMsSplitHint: Select one PDF and split each page into its own PDF file.
pdfMsExtractHint: Select one PDF and extract pages by ranges; output as a single file or one file per range.
pdfMsSelectMultiple: Click to select multiple PDF files
pdfMsSelectOne: Click to select a PDF file
pdfMsLoadError: Failed to read「{{name}}」. The file may be damaged.
pdfMsRangeExample: Comma-separated. Use 5 for a single page, 1-3 for a range. Pages start at 1.
pdfMsRangeInvalid: Invalid page format. Use something like 1-3,5,7-10
pdfMsRangeOutOfBounds: Page out of range. This PDF has {{max}} page(s)
pdfMsMergeNeedTwo: Select at least two PDF files
pdfMsProcessError: Processing failed. Check the PDF and try again.
annoOpenHint: Supports PDF or image files. Open one, then drag to draw highlight annotations.
annoAnnotateHint: Drag on the preview to draw highlight boxes

annoClearConfirm: Clear all annotations for this file?
annoEmpty: No annotations yet. Enable annotate mode and drag on the preview.
annoCoordsOrigin: Origin (0, 0) is the top-left corner of the page
annoInvalidFile: Cannot read the file. Choose a valid PDF or image.
annoNoFile: Open a PDF or image file first
annoDrawTooSmall: Drag area is too small, no annotation added
lanDesc: Share files over your local network. Other devices open the web interface in a browser to view and transfer files.
lanNetworkIpHint: When the computer has multiple network adapters, pick the LAN IP reachable by the target device.
lanDefaultHint: Defaults to the system Downloads folder. Customize above.

lanUseHint: On the same LAN, open the address below in a browser:
lanQrHint: Scan with your phone to open
lanStartFail: Failed to start the service. Check folder permissions.
lanTokenHint: One-time token, already embedded in the link and QR code above. Peers can also enter it manually.
